Markets.title: US stocks: S&P 500 notches record-high close as rate-hike worries ease
Markets.summary: The S&P 500 reached a record-high close driven by technology stocks and easing Federal Reserve rate-hike worries due to stable producer inflation. Memory chip makers SanDisk and Micron Technology saw significant stock gains alongside major firms like Broadcom and Meta Platforms.

Markets.title: Average pay of CEOs of S&P 500 companies rose to record $22.8 million following Elon Musk's nearly $1 trillion compensation, AFL-CIO finds
Markets.summary: The average pay for S&P 500 CEOs reached a record $22.8 million, driven largely by Elon Musk's massive compensation package. This increase comes as regular employee wages face pressure from artificial intelligence and shifting labor board policies.

Markets.title: Fed’s Barkin says rate hike an ‘open question’; Hammack backs increase on inflation concerns
Markets.summary: Richmond Fed President Tom Barkin considers further interest rate hikes an open question. Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack advocates for an immediate rate increase due to concerns that business borrowing pressures are fueling inflation.

Markets.title: FPIs emerge as biggest sellers among anchor investors in IPOs' 30-day window: Sebi study
Markets.summary: A Sebi study shows that foreign portfolio investors were the largest anchor investor sellers during the 30-day post-IPO lock-in window. Smaller initial public offerings experienced heavier anchor selling, which often pressured stock prices and continued significantly beyond the required lock-in period.

Markets.title: Bill Ackman adds Netflix, Visa & Mastercard in biggest portfolio shake-up in years
Markets.summary: Investor Bill Ackman added Netflix, Visa, and Mastercard to his portfolio in a major shake-up. His funds also acquired stakes in Alcon, Intercontinental Exchange, S&P Global, and Microsoft.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Friday
Markets.summary: Indian benchmark indices moved in opposite directions on expiry day, with the Sensex rising 114 points and the Nifty dropping over 40 points. Softer inflation boosted sentiment, but high crude prices and geopolitical tensions kept the Nifty rangebound.

Geo-Political.title: Palestinians told to leave homes in village where Israeli settlers besieged houses
Geo-Political.summary: The mayor of Qusra stated that Israeli troops are ordering Palestinian families to leave their homes. Soldiers are also using some of these evacuated houses as military barracks.

Geo-Political.title: Romania shuts only nuclear plant as heat causes huge drop in Danube River level
Geo-Political.summary: Romania shut down its only nuclear power plant because low water levels in the Danube River caused by extreme heat threatened operations. The Cernavodă facility, which generates 20% of the country's electricity, is expected to remain closed for at least 10 days.

Geo-Political.title: Putin can no longer claim victory in Ukraine, Nobel Peace Prize winner tells BBC
Geo-Political.summary: Nobel Peace Prize winner Dmitry Muratov told the BBC that Vladimir Putin can no longer claim victory in Ukraine. Muratov stated that the Kremlin leader can only destroy the country rather than conquer it, as the war enters its fifth year.

Geo-Political.title: Conditions on US aircraft carrier at sea for more than 250 days raise alarms
Geo-Political.summary: Sailors aboard the US aircraft carrier Abraham Lincoln have faced severe conditions, including food shortages and broken plumbing, after spending more than 250 days at sea. These extreme circumstances have led to plummeting morale, with some crew members reportedly considering jumping overboard.

Geo-Political.title: Person fined after using foghorn to wake sleeping polar bear
Geo-Political.summary: A person was fined under local regulations for using a foghorn to wake a sleeping polar bear. The law strictly prohibits needlessly disturbing, attracting, or pursuing polar bears in the region.

Geo-Political.title: Eurovision Song Contest 2027 to be held in Burgas, Bulgaria
Geo-Political.summary: Burgas, Bulgaria, will host the 2027 Eurovision Song Contest. The Black Sea city was chosen following Bulgarian singer Dara's victory in this year's competition.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An author tested ChatGPT to see if their WordPress SaaS course would be recommended without paid advertising. The AI recommended their course as the top result, demonstrating a new method for gaining organic traffic.

Data & Insights.title: India’s merchandise trade gap widens to a six-month high of $31.98 bn in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's merchandise trade gap widened to a six-month high of $31.98 billion in July. Meanwhile, merchandise exports for the April-July period rose 17% to $173.78 billion compared to the previous year.

Data & Insights.title: US consumer inflation falls to 3.4% year-on-year in July: Govt
Data & Insights.summary: US consumer inflation slowed to 3.4% year-on-year in July amid volatile oil prices. The consumer price index rose 0.1% from the previous month, matching analyst expectations and potentially giving the Federal Reserve more flexibility on interest rates.

Data & Insights.title: India's retail inflation breaches RBI's midpoint target for second successive month, rises to 4.45% in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 4.45% in July, surpassing the Reserve Bank of India's 4% midpoint target for the second consecutive month. This increase was driven by rising food and fuel prices, compounded by the risks of elevated global oil prices.

Data & Insights.title: Fitch retains India's BBB- sovereign credit rating for 20th year, forecasts GDP growth at 6.4% — Here's what it means
Data & Insights.summary: Fitch Ratings has kept India's sovereign credit rating at BBB- for the twentieth consecutive year due to a strong economic growth outlook, while projecting a 6.4% GDP growth rate. The agency also highlighted potential fiscal risks stemming from youth protests over employment issues.

Data & Insights.title: The Sanjeev Sanyal interview: A new age of ideas for India
Data & Insights.summary: Sanjeev Sanyal states that artificial intelligence is making traditional university education obsolete. He also emphasizes that improving employability is a greater challenge for India than simply creating jobs.

Data & Insights.title: India retail inflation likely remained unchanged at 4.4% in July: Mint poll
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation in July is projected to have stayed flat at 4.4%. A favorable base effect and subdued underlying inflation offset higher food prices.

India.title: IIT Kharagpur 2nd-Year Student Dies After Falling From Hostel Building
India.summary: A second-year engineering student at IIT Kharagpur died on Thursday after falling from the fourth floor of a campus hostel building. Authorities are currently investigating the circumstances surrounding the fatal incident in West Bengal.

India.title: 1991 Jammu Blast Accused Arrested After 35 Years, Was Hiding As Businessman
India.summary: Altaf Hussain Sheikh, an accused in the 1991 Jammu blast, was arrested after evading authorities for 35 years. He was captured in South Kashmir, where he had been living under a false identity as a businessman.

India.title: 'Judiciary Does Not Take Sides, Constitution Supreme': Chief Justice
India.summary: India's Chief Justice stated in an interview that the judiciary remains neutral and does not take sides. He emphasized that the Constitution is the nation's greatest power and that protecting its basic structure is the judiciary's primary role.

India.title: 6 Killed, 2 Trapped As Water, Debris Enter Tunnel In Uttarakhand's Chamoli
India.summary: Six people died and two others remained trapped after water and debris surged into an under-construction hydropower project tunnel in Chamoli, Uttarakhand. District Magistrate Gaurav Kumar stated that the incident occurred around 6:30 p.m.

India.title: Vijay Writes To PM Modi, Urges Him To Freeze Lok Sabha Seats At 543
India.summary: Actor-turned-politician Vijay has urged Prime Minister Narendra Modi to freeze the number of Lok Sabha seats at 543. He highlighted a recent Tamil Nadu Assembly resolution concerning the proposed delimitation of constituencies and the implementation of women's reservation.

India.title: Man Assaults, Shows Obscene Video To Woman Cab Driver In Gurugram, Arrested
India.summary: A man in Gurugram was arrested after allegedly assaulting a woman cab driver and showing her an obscene video. The victim recorded the incident on her phone and shared the video on social media, where it subsequently went viral.

General.title: Watch: Houses engulfed in flames across Stourbridge
General.summary: Multiple fires broke out across the West Midlands, destroying homes in the region. The blazes caused severe damage to houses, particularly in Stourbridge.

General.title: UK sees hottest day of the year as 38.1C recorded in Kew Gardens
General.summary: The UK recorded its hottest day of the year after temperatures reached 38.1C in Kew Gardens. An amber extreme heat warning remains in effect for parts of England until midnight.

General.title: Five key takeaways from results day 2026
General.summary: Results day 2026 shows an increase in top grades and students heading to university. Technical subjects are also growing in popularity.

General.title: Son of 102-year-old says father died after being 'pushed off stage'
General.summary: Phillip Ormerod, a 102-year-old man, died in the hospital after his son reported he was pushed off a stage. Police have confirmed the incident and his subsequent death.
